attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.file_id WHERE i.is_internal AND (i.module_name = 'auto_ontology.connectors' OR i.module_name LIKE 'auto_ontology.connectors.%') AND NOT f.is_test AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%' ORDER BY file_path

request:
Which non-test Python files anywhere in the repository (including folders outside the auto_ontology package, such as dev_tools/) but outside the auto_ontology/connectors/ folder import anything from the connectors package (auto_ontology.connectors itself or any of its modules)? Count every import statement, including imports placed inside functions and imports under an `if TYPE_CHECKING:` guard; mentions in comments or docstrings are not imports. Every file under a tests/ folder is test code and is excluded. Return repository-relative file paths.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: Joins internal imports to their importing files and selects those whose imported module is auto_ontology.connectors or a submodule. It excludes test files (is_test or any tests/ folder) and files inside auto_ontology/connectors/, returning distinct repository-relative paths.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.file_id WHERE i.is_internal AND (i.module_name = 'auto_ontology.connectors' OR i.module_name LIKE 'auto_ontology.connectors.%') AND NOT f.is_test AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%' ORDER BY file_path
